title: Crispy Fried Gnocchi
description: A simple yet satisfying Italian-inspired dish that combines soft gnocchi with a crunchy fried crust.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
2. In a bowl, combine flour, egg, milk, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to form a smooth dough.
3. Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes elastic.
4. Divide the dough into 4 equal parts and roll each part into a long rope.
5. Cut the rope into 1-inch pieces to form the gnocchi.
6. Dip each gnocchi into the flour, then the beaten egg, and finally the breadcrumbs to coat.
7. Carefully place the coated gnocchi into the hot oil.
8. Fry the gnocchi for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden brown and crispy.
9. Remove the fried gnocchi from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
10. Serve the crispy fried gnocchi hot and enjoy!
